33081.ov: Kishanlal marries the beautiful Lachchi, but the day after the wedding, he leaves on business for five years. When Kishanlal reappears only a few days later, Lachchi is delighted, but this new Kishanlal is in fact a spirit who has taken the form of Lachchi's husband, after having seen her by chance and fallen in love…
ml: When a Man Loves a Woman

48569.ov: Aditya, an engineer, travels to Canada for training. There he meets Jia, a beautiful woman from an influential family. Fate keeps pushing the pair together, and even though both are already betrothed to others, Adi and Jia fall in love.

54969.ov: A notorious gangster asks a career thief by the name of Nandu to steal a package worth over one crore rupees for a fee.

71481.ov: A brilliant student starts hallucinating after moving into a room that was occupied by another who committed suicide.

103865.ov: Ajit saves the village from the dakus (bandits); whilst having romance with Anju.

118841.ov: Raja Bhaiya (Mithun Chakraborty) and his friend Charan (Satish Kaushik) come to a city to make a living.  Failed in their attempts to find a job, one day, they are teased and ragged by Kallu Dada (Ranjeet).  The quarrel gets physical, which Raja wins.

134841.ov: One half of an identical set of twins, the mischievous Chunni is known in her hometown for the pranks she plays, notably on her father, the schoolteacher and the village butcher. To get out of trouble, Chunni often impersonates her sister Munni and makes others look a fool.

154937.ov: A Delhi university guy is after a girl he likes in a fashion show. In process he comes across a sting operation tape of a politician buying ministers for his government. Guy who use to talk big against 'corruption' comes in lure of money like any layman does on opportunity.
ml: The Return of the Pink Panther

285753.ov: Tyrannical and wealthy Veer Pratap Singh, rules over a small town - ruthlessly. Whoever opposes him is crushed. He is attracted to women, and has a lengthy affair with Soundariya, and even has a secret marriage ceremony with her. When Soundariya gets pregnant, he asks her to abort the child.

302905.ov: A newspaper reporter exploits an ordinary man for few rupees to pose as a man who is fighting against the corrupt politicians and prints imaginary stories in his name to improve the circulation of her newspaper. People take him for real and he becomes a powerful leader of poor man.

305337.ov: Romance meets crime drama, when Nisha and Sunil are wed, but face the consequences of Sunil's brother's questionable business associates.

306361.ov: Due to a growing marital rift between Jamuna and her husband, she decides to leave him. He does not permit her to take their son, so she arranges his abduction, and disappears from her husband's life. Years later, Jamuna's son, Mohan, has grown up, and together they live a middle-class existence.
ml: The Map of Tiny Perfect Things

307513.ov: In the state of Madhya Pradesh, India, particularly in the Chambal Ravine there are abundance of bandit gangs, chiefly consisting of Brahmans and Thakurs, both carrying on their age-old rivalry and hatred for each other from generation to generation.

359865.ov: Anajali is taken far away from the city by police officer Karan. Her life is in danger as an eye witness in a murder case.

365497.ov: Filmmaker and gay activist Sridhar Rangayan embarks on a personal journey to expose the human rights violations faced by the LGBTQ community in India due to a draconian law Section 377 and homophobic social mores of a patriarchal society.

403513.ov: A Weekend in Goa with friends is a dream but what when they go missing? With a New undercover inspector in town? Find out the story of Laksh and his friends.

464441.ov: As a crazed killer blazes a trail of blood through an anxious city, a hardened cop aims to take him down by any means in this remake of Dirty Harry.

493625.ov: Vijay wants to become a singer but his father doesn't support him. Meanwhile, Daksha, a beautiful girl, comes to stay in the same community where Vijay lives and transforms their lives.

505785.ov: Baadal has a bitter rivalry with Thakur Kiran Singh, who plans to usurp his land to avenge his father's death. However, when Kiran's sister Meenakshi falls for Baadal, it creates complications.

532921.ov: A series of events leading up to the final confrontation between Rama and Ravana. During the battle, Rama and Lakshmana are captured by Mahiravana, an evil sorcerer who is the brother and ally of Ravana.

559673.ov: Eight year-old Hamid learns that 786 is God's number and decides to try and reach out to God, by dialing this number. He wants to talk to his father, who his mother tells him has gone to Allah. One fine day the phone call is answered.

579001.ov: Suggestions of ancient and modern myths and folklore coalesce in dreams to bring alive a colourful animated world.

617785.ov: Anand is looking to arrest the woman who killed his father, unaware that she's his own mother

683193.ov: A story about the trials and tribulations of retired soldier Satyapati and his sons
ml: The Boy Who Harnessed the Wind

727225.ov: Professor Vijay Tripathi and Bhujbal Choudhury have a small land dispute between themselves forcing Bhujbal and his men to mercilessly kill Vijay making his death look as though lightning struck him.

801337.ov: Based on a true story, ‘Chhatrabhang’ explores caste dynamics in a drought stricken village in rural India. This complex film transforms a 3 line news report into a lyrical feature film about the trauma of dilemma, and the processes involved in resolve, change and reform.

945337.ov: Sukhpreet ‘Sukhee’ Kalra, a 38-year-old Punjabi housewife, goes to Delhi to attend her school reunion. Sukhee relives the 17-year-old version of herself whilst going through a plethora of experiences in a span of just seven days, coming out rekindled, reborn and making the most difficult transition in her life – from…

978489.ov: Bhanwar, a simpleton young man in the rural Rajasthan wants a bride for him but gets duped. Instead of a woman, he is married off to a transgender person – Sanwri.

1000377.ov: A Nawab belonging to the Chandni Chowk area of Delhi gets tricked into marrying his daughter to the gardener's son.

1179065.ov: A Khilonewala (Toy seller) comes to sell beautiful hand-crafted toys to children when religious fanaticism turns the atmosphere upside down

1200697.ov: A 1988 Hindi-language film directed by Khwaja Ahmad Abbas, and the final film of his career, presented by Naya Sansar.

1265977.ov: Rahul Sinha, a famous photojournalist, returns to his alma mater as a guest speaker and takes a nostalgic trip down memory lane to relive his carefree school days and the moment he first fell in love.

1441977.ov: Two couples navigate modern relationships while a woman pioneers installing public toilets for females across rural India, breaking taboos.

1516473.ov: A great drama of life & humanity that's exploring profound human experiences and societal themes

1727033.ov: Adapted from the short stories of Pakistani writer Saadat Hasan Manto, the film interweaves the lives of three sex workers and their pimps.

tv256057.ov: Suspended Inspector Gadar Singh is summoned to a crime scene where the Chandel family is found hanging. One of them survives, leading to media frenzy and speculation of murder.

tv103225.ov: Jestination Unknown is an attempt to answer the question, what does India find funny? The clubs and pubs of India's metros are only a sliver of an answer to that question. English stand-up comedy maybe new in India but comedy itself isn't new to the country.

tv280889.ov: Rishabh and Surbhi, two young individuals, find themselves at the crossroads of an arranged marriage. The story unfolds in two timelines: one in Mumbai, in the past, and another in Madhya Pradesh, where their families meet.
